### backup-audit-manager-audits-policies-against-controls

**Claim.** AWS Backup Audit Manager audits the compliance of your backup policies against controls that you define; a control is a procedure that audits a backup requirement such as backup frequency or retention period.

**Write it as.** `audit the compliance of your AWS Backup policies` · `backup frequency or the backup retention period`

**Scope.** AWS Backup Audit Manager.

### backup-aurora-vault-snapshots-no-charge-condition

**Claim.** AWS does not charge for Aurora snapshots in a backup vault as long as Aurora automated backups are enabled and their retention period is longer than the retention period of the Aurora snapshots; snapshots whose database was deleted are charged.

**Write it as.** `does not charge for Aurora snapshots` · `charged if the snapshots' database is deleted`

**Scope.** Aurora snapshots in an AWS Backup vault; Aurora automated backups enabled and automated-backup retention longer than snapshot retention.

> "AWS does not charge for Aurora snapshots stored inside a backup vault as long as Aurora has automated backups enabled and the retention period for Aurora automated backups is more than the retention period of Aurora snapshots. Any snapshots within the backup vault will be charged if the snapshots’ database is deleted (deletions may occur accidentally or during blue/green deployment)."
> — [How AWS Backup works with supported AWS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/working-with-supported-services.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-14.
